phase_2_fix_summary: DEFERRED. Static analysis identified two candidate fixes (fix-H_F.1 at claudeRemote.ts:191-214 and fix-H_F.3 at apiSession.ts:151-155) but cannot conclusively determine which is the root cause without runtime evidence. Specifically: claudeRemote.ts has updateThinking(true) ONLY at lines 162 (before for-await) and 175 (system+init). Line 192 calls updateThinking(false) on result, then line 208 awaits next user message. After messages.push at line 214, the for-await continues but no updateThinking(true) is fired. HOWEVER, this would mean ALL conversation turns after the first show thinking=false — which contradicts normal user observation that babbling DOES appear on each turn. This implies either (a) the SDK fires another system+init message on each turn boundary (re-triggering line 175), OR (b) Claude Code SDK behaviour I cannot statically verify. The newly-landed [REMOTE-THINKING] log key will resolve this within one bg-task reproduction journalctl capture. Per BA spec R3 ('inferred-only fix is REJECTED') and task statement 'do NOT skip Phase 2; apply only if static evidence is overwhelming', the static evidence is NOT overwhelming and Phase 2 is correctly deferred.

h_f_1_static_findings.claim: After result (line 192) sets thinking=false, no code path sets thinking=true within the same claudeRemote() invocation unless a new system+init message arrives.
h_f_1_static_findings.uncertainty: Whether Claude SDK emits system+init on each turn boundary (per --resume semantics) is not statically verifiable. Runtime [REMOTE-THINKING] log would show this in 1 reproduction.
h_f_1_static_findings.fix_target_if_confirmed: claudeRemote.ts: add updateThinking(true) on first 'assistant' message after a result without preceding init. ~3 lines.
